_comment: Single source of truth for ticker lifecycle status and data-quality holds. 'status' is a fact about the company: active (still reporting) or acquired (bought out / taken private / merged away, so it will never report again). 'exclude_from_active' drops a ticker from the active analysis universe at load - true for every acquired ticker, because a company frozen in 2019 does not belong in a 2026 sector benchmark, and also true for tickers held back purely for data quality. Acquired rows are NOT deleted: load with include_excluded=True to study what a company looked like in the quarters before its acquisition. Acquisition dates are from company announcements and SEC filings; 'announced' is the anchor for pre-acquisition profiling because that is when the market learns.

BABA.reason: Verified 2026-09-06: NOT an error. The 55-day gap between 2026-03-19 and 2026-05-13 is real. Alibaba announced its December 2025 quarter unusually late, on 2026-03-19, then the March quarter and full year on 2026-05-13; both dates are confirmed by Alibaba's own announcements.

BNY.reason: Ticker renamed from BK to BNY on 2026-05-21 when the company completed its rebrand to BNY; historical rows were relabelled so the company keeps one identity across the panel. The missing Q2'26 row (reported 2026-07-15, EPS $2.45, revenue $5,698M) was backfilled on 2026-09-06.

BRK/B.reason: Resolved 2026-09-06. The 10 missing quarters (Q2'17-Q3'19) were backfilled from SEC XBRL: revenue reconciles exactly to Berkshire's reported annual totals for 2017, 2018 and 2019, and EPS (operating earnings per equivalent Class B share) lands within 0.02 of the reported figure each year. Index alignment now matches every other ticker.
BRK/B.resolution: Back in the active universe. Note Q2'16 (2.03) and Q3'16 (2.92) still look high against Berkshire's reported operating earnings of $4,610M and $4,850M, which imply 1.87 and 1.97.

EA.reason: Largest all-cash leveraged buyout on record. Last report Q4'26 on 2026-05-05; the buyout closed 2026-08-04, so no further reports will come.
EA.resolution: Retained as an acquisition profile; excluded from active analysis.

HAIN.reason: WATCH ONLY. Not acquired - still trading on Nasdaq - but it fell out of compliance with the $1.00 minimum bid price rule and plans a reverse split. Its 115-day reporting gap is not an acquisition signal.
HAIN.resolution: Watch for a delisting or reverse split; re-check status if it stops reporting.
